mapper.sql: a.id, s.id AS store_id, a.customer_id, a.credit_limit, a.remark, a.create_time, a.update_time, s.code AS store_code, s.name AS store_name, s.franchisee, s.settle_mode, s.status AS store_status, s.contract_start, s.contract_end, c.code AS customer_code, c.name AS customer_name, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.amount - b.settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_bill b WHERE b.kind = 'AR' AND b.partner_id = a.customer_id AND b.status <> 'SETTLED') AS receivable, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(v.amount - v.used_amount), 0) FROM fin_advance v WHERE v.kind = 'RECEIPT' AND v.partner_id = a.customer_id) AS prepaid, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.kind = 'RECEIVE' THEN p.amount ELSE -p.amount END), 0) FROM chain_franchise_deposit p WHERE p.store_id = s.id) AS deposit_balance
mapper.select: SELECT FROM store_info s LEFT JOIN chain_franchise_account a ON a.store_id = s.id LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = a.customer_id WHERE s.id = #{storeId}
